text: On March 27th, we received an information request to provide a presentation by Spinal Cord Injury Ontario (SCIO) on the topic of Accessible Taxis and Vehicle for Hire Services. Upon research conducted by the SCIO community, we have learned that finding a wheelchair accessible Taxi or Vehicle for Hire Service has become increasingly difficult in the Greater Toronto Area (GTA) since the pandemic. People with disabilities are waiting record times to get access to transportation that their fellow residents without disabilities can access in under ten minutes. It is for this reason that we believe Spinal Cord Injury Ontario should have the opportunity to speak at the upcoming Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee. They are a provincial organization that specialize in serving people with spinal cord injuries and other disabilities. As such, they regularly hear the lived experience…

The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee: 1. Invited Spinal Cord Injury Ontario to do a presentation on the topic of Accessible Taxis and Vehicle for Hire Services at Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee’s meeting on June 24, 2024.
